info.title: RealmForge Control API
info.description: Governance kernel REST API — session, command, audit, snapshot, rollback, boards, and more.

get.summary: Basic liveness check.
Get the full ActorScope for an actor and session.
Verify the integrity of the full audit hash chain for a project.
Query audit events for a project with optional filters and pagination.
Stream audit events for a project as Server-Sent Events (SSE).
get.description:
SSE endpoint — streams audit events for a project as they arrive.
Reconnect-safe: pass the `Last-Event-ID` header with the last received
event's offset to resume without gaps.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID to stream events for

get.summary: List board plans with optional status filter and pagination.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by board state. One of: draft, in_review, approved, in_progress, completed, blocked, archived.

post.summary: Create a new board plan for a work path.
Approve a board plan submitted for review.
Reject a board plan and return it to draft.
Submit a draft board plan for approval.

400.description: Invalid plan ID or state transition

post.summary: Submit a release command from an approved board plan.

get.summary: List bundle manifests, optionally filtered by app ID.

post.summary: Create a new bundle manifest with artifact hashes and governance signature.

get.summary: Get a bundle manifest by ID.

post.summary: Mark a verified bundle as deployed.
Update bundle status to verified, signed, or failed.

get.summary: List catalog entries at a given scope (global, tenant, or app).

post.summary: Copy a catalog module to a new scope, recording provenance.

get.summary: Get the copy provenance chain for a catalog entry.

post.summary: Propose a new bounded command within the command lifecycle.

get.summary: Retrieve a command by ID.

put.summary: Apply an authorized command, executing its effects.
Authorize a proposed command against the policy engine.

post.summary: Explicitly deny a command, recording the reason in the audit trail.
Execute a command through the agent gateway. Every agent write must go through this endpoint.

requestBody.description: GatewayRequest: actor_id, session_id, action, file_paths, schema_views

get.summary: Liveness probe — service process is running.
Readiness probe — service is ready to accept traffic.
List all indexed knowledge datasets.
Get metadata for a specific knowledge dataset.

post.summary: Query knowledge records by scope, type, and text filters.

requestBody.description: KnowledgeQuery fields: scope, record_type, tags, text_contains, limit, offset

get.summary: Get the Live Watch monitoring profile for an app.

put.summary: Update the Live Watch monitoring profile for an app.

get.summary: List remediation proposals for an app.

post.summary: Approve a remediation proposal, authorizing its execution.
Propose a remediation action based on current signal state.

get.summary: List recorded signals for an app, optionally filtered by type and severity.

post.summary: Record a runtime signal (latency, error_rate, cost_rate, etc.) for an app.
Enable Live Watch monitoring for an app.
Disable Live Watch monitoring for an app.
Authenticate an actor and issue a session token.

get.summary: List active login blocks (rate-limit lockouts) for a tenant.

post.summary: Set the login policy (rate limits, block duration) for a tenant.

get.summary: Get the active login policy for a tenant.

post.summary: Execute a rollback, restoring state from an earlier snapshot.
Preview what a rollback between two snapshots would restore. Does not execute.

get.summary: Verify a rollback snapshot's consistency and hash integrity.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Snapshot ID of the rollback result

get.summary: List all active runtime instances.

post.summary: Deploy a bundle as a new runtime instance.

get.summary: Get the current status of a runtime instance.

post.summary: Stop a running runtime instance.
Issue a new session for an actor within a tenant and project.

get.summary: Get session details by ID.

delete.summary: Revoke a session, preventing further use.

post.summary: Activate an issued session, transitioning it from issued to active.
Extend a session's TTL.

get.summary: List snapshots for the default project with pagination.

post.summary: Create a new content-addressed snapshot manifest.

get.summary: Compare two snapshots and return the delta (added, removed, changed objects).

404.description: One or both snapshots not found

get.summary: Get a snapshot by ID, returning its validation report.

post.summary: Validate a snapshot's manifest hash integrity and object reference consistency.
Generate a scoped work packet for an AI agent from a work path node.
Validate a work packet's scope boundaries and cost budget.
Create a new work path graph.

get.summary: Get a work path graph by ID.

post.summary: Traverse a work path node and generate a scoped work packet.

CommandScopeRequest.description:
Typed request body for command authorization and application endpoints.
Mirrors the ActorScope fields so utoipa can generate a schema without
requiring ActorScope to implement ToSchema.

status.description: Filter by board state. One of: draft, in_review, approved, in_progress, completed, blocked, archived.

ProblemDetails.description:
RFC 7807 Problem Details response, extended with a machine-readable error code
and trace ID per the RealmForge API error standard.

code.description: Machine-readable SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE error code. Stable across versions.

trace_id.description: Correlation ID matching the X-Request-Id response header.

ProfileBody.description: Body for updating a watch profile.
